oracle.summary: The PR adds partial access tracking to SecureCookieSession but leaves key-only session operations untracked, allowing an accessed session response to omit Vary: Cookie.
oracle.expected_behavior: __contains__ and len-style key-only access must mark session access before response caching policy is emitted.

matching.tp: A finding identifies the missing access tracking for key-only session operations or its Vary: Cookie consequence in the changed session implementation.
matching.fp: Any finding unrelated to the frozen defect.
